unexercised_explicit.0x12c00 / 0x12d80 / 0x2dfac: Other 0x537e0/0x53800 consumers are outside this source recovery; their wider or absent local bounds are not inferred from the 0x12620 caller.

ordering: The candidate keeps 0x12790 order: timer/movement; selected-row reset and 0x29260; 0x28820 source interpreter; conditional second 0x29260 then 0x3870 cancellation; reload context pointer and apply mask/position flags. The cancellation fixture checks callback fields clear while residency remains 2 before source resource_cancel changes it to 4.
fixture_setup_resolution: An initial residency_state=2 row-lifecycle test faulted because the test left the native copied-interface cancel slot at 0x70f44 null. The 0x2c260 disassembly is `jmp dword ptr [0x70f44]`; after seeding native and source interface views with the same no-argument callback spy, the state-2 case passes and confirms callbacks are cleared while residency is still 2, before the provider changes it to 4. The spy returns zero and does not model the external host operation.
